purpose: Technical and cost feasibility of matched-prefix cross-model transfer. Establishes that the live provider accepts the declared Haiku 4.5 policy, that the explicit transfer fork preserves the saved prefix and board, and what a continuation actually costs. NOT a powered transfer test.
not_used_for: Confirmatory transfer labels or effect claims.
Any statement about the target model's own failure taxonomy.

selection.rule: Three Holm-resolved harmful decisions, two helpful-direction controls, one early unresolved case and two flat controls, covering all four represented starting positions. Selection is fixed by M2 statistics and is independent of the behavioural taxonomy labels.

arm_definitions.keep_original_reply: Restore the checkpoint, force the complete original Haiku 5.5 reply exactly once, then every later call uses the target model.
arm_definitions.redecide_reply: Restore the checkpoint; the target model decides immediately.

design.paired: Both arms run from the identical before-step checkpoint.
design.randomisation: None. Replicates differ only by provider sampling; the prefix, board and policy are identical by construction.

target.listed_status: Active (legacy); docs advise migrating to Haiku 5.5
target.retirement_stated: not sooner than 2026-10-15; no firm date published

reference.role: original M2 model; not dispatched in this stage

models.policy_source: m3_runtime/policies.py (registry fingerprint recorded at run time)
models.declared_change: M3 sets drop_params=False where M2 recorded True, and Haiku 4.5 uses an explicit 4096-token thinking budget where Haiku 5.5 used adaptive thinking. This is a declared model-policy transfer, not isolation of model weights.

descriptive_only: recovery rate per arm per decision, with interval, labelled non-confirmatory
metrics.multiplicity: None applied. No confirmatory claim is made from this stage. The confirmation stage will declare and freeze its own Holm family before its outcomes are collected.

budget.shared: One transactional cap across all jobs and worker processes.
budget.proxy_basis: same-usage proxy from M2 token counts at current Haiku 4.5 list prices
budget.note: Proxy may overestimate input tokens: Haiku 5.5's newer tokenizer yields about 30% more tokens for the same text. It may underestimate output if the 4096-token thinking budget exceeds Haiku 5.5's adaptive usage.
budget.unknown_usage_policy: Maximum liability retained until usage and model identity are confirmed.

stopping_and_interruption.hard_stop: Budget cap; no call starts that could exceed it.
stopping_and_interruption.on_transport_failure: Stop the run. No retries are configured or permitted.
stopping_and_interruption.resume: Completed job_ids are skipped on restart. Reservations survive interruption; no paid prefix is redrawn.
abort_conditions: Any response whose model id is not the pinned target.
Any fork that fails prefix, board or non-policy context verification.

authorization.authorized_by: Linu (project owner), approved in the working session
authorization.note: Approves this 160-continuation technical/cost pilot only, up to the $15 ceiling. Does not approve the later confirmation stage, and no unused M2 allowance is reused.

pre_run_amendments.change: run_m3_pilot.py keeps preflight and live records in separate files
pre_run_amendments.reason: Live resume read the preflight results.json and would have skipped all 160 jobs.

pre_run_amendments.change: run_m3_pilot.py restores the real socket functions in live mode only
pre_run_amendments.reason: m3_offline_common blocks the network on import, so every live request would have failed before reaching the provider.

With drop_params=False litellm 1.104.2 rejects service_tier for Anthropic client-side. M2 sent it with drop_params=True, so litellm silently dropped it and it never reached the provider; omitting it matches M2's wire request. The standard tier is still verified on every response.

pre_run_amendments.change: m3_runtime/transport.py sends inference_geo only to Haiku 5.5
pre_run_amendments.reason: The first live request was rejected before inference (400: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 does not support inference_geo). M2 sent inference_geo=global to Haiku 5.5; without the parameter Haiku 4.5 uses the default global routing. Responses are still checked for a global geo. Earlier attempts that day were rejected before inference with an invalid API key; all rejected attempts cost $0 and are kept as rejected_*_20261122_*.json.

pre_run_amendments.change: m3_runtime/policies.py accepts inference_geo="not_available" for Haiku 4.5 only (EXPECTED_GEO); Haiku 5.5 still requires "global"
pre_run_amendments.reason: Two live requests were answered by claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, but the usage they returned reports inference_geo="not_available" and the normalizer accepted only "global", so both kept the maximum $0.33 liability ($0.66 in all) and the runner stopped before any game finished. No outcome was recorded; their liabilities stay in the ledger as uncertain_maximum_retained. One separate diagnostic call outside the ledger (42 input, 40 output tokens, about $0.0002) captured the usage shape.
